title: The Rebalance Loop
subtitle: Consumers repeatedly lose partitions and make no progress

brief.narrative: A handler takes longer than max.poll.interval.ms. The coordinator removes it, reassigns partitions, and the next consumer repeats the same slow work.
symptoms: Consumer Group metrics diverge from the service-level symptom
The problem reproduces only under the triggering workload
Logs contain enough evidence to distinguish cause from consequence
brief.objective: Identify the root cause, select a production-safe fix, and explain the trade-off.

rootCause.question: Which root cause explains all of the evidence?

options.text: Processing exceeded the poll interval and triggered repeated consumer-group rebalances.
options.feedback: Correct. Rebalance safety requires pausing intake, finishing or cancelling work, and committing only completed offsets. Tuning one timeout cannot fix unbounded work.

options.text: Server-Side Request Forgery let an attacker choose a privileged network destination.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Authentication was present, but object-level authorization was missing.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: The create operation lacked a stable idempotency key and replayed a committed side effect.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

fix.question: Which fix is safest for production?

options.text: Allowlist schemes/destinations, resolve and validate every hop, block private/link-local ranges at egress, limit redirects, and isolate the fetcher.

options.text: Enforce authorization in the data access boundary with tenant/user scope, deny by default, and test cross-tenant IDs.
